name: Ecology, Evolution, and Biodiversity (EEB)
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Biology
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Biology department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: First Year Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: From approved HU-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved NS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved SS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Additional Distribution: complete 3 areas
requirements.hint: Pick any 3 of the area buckets below and hit 3 cr in each. ID credit can count toward 1, 2, or all 3 areas, so the extra ID buckets can stand in for additional areas.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Humanities.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Natural Sciences.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Social Sciences.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Mathematical & Symbolic Analysis
requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Creative Expression
requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Interdisciplinary
requirements.hint: From approved ID-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Second Area)
requirements.hint: A second 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a second area.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Third Area)
requirements.hint: A third 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a third area.

requirements.label: Introductory Biology Sequence
requirements.hint: Choose Sequence A, B, or C. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Sequence A: BIOLOGY 171, 172 or 174, and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 171, one of BIOLOGY 172 or 174, and BIOLOGY 173. 3 courses total.

requirements.label: Sequence B: BIOLOGY 195 and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 195 (AP credit) plus BIOLOGY 173. 2 courses total.

requirements.label: Sequence C: BIOLOGY 191, 192, and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 191 (transfer credit), BIOLOGY 192, and BIOLOGY 173. 3 courses total.

requirements.label: Chemistry Sequence: CHEM 210 & 211
requirements.hint: CHEM 210 (Structure and Reactivity I) and CHEM 211 (Investigations in Chemistry). 2 courses total.

requirements.label: Quantitative Analysis Sequence
requirements.hint: 3 courses from the department's approved quantitative list (math, statistics, computing). Approximated here as MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: Core: Ecology
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 281 or 282, plus EEB 372 or 373. 2 courses total. EEB 381 (at UMBS) taken prior to Spring 2022 also satisfies this.

requirements.label: BIOLOGY 305: Genetics
requirements.hint: Core genetics requirement.

requirements.label: Core: Evolution
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EEB 390, 391, or 392

requirements.label: Core: Biochemistry or Quantitative Analysis 4
requirements.hint: 3 credits from the approved list: either a biochemistry course or a 4th quantitative analysis course.

requirements.label: Biochemistry Option
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: MCDB 310, BIOLCHEM 415, or CHEM 351. 3 credits.

requirements.label: Quantitative Analysis 4 Option
requirements.hint: A 4th course from the approved quantitative list, beyond the 3 prerequisite courses. Approximated here as 4 total MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: Capstone: EEB 410
requirements.hint: EEB 410 (EEB Capstone Seminar).

requirements.label: Upper-Level Elective: EEB 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: 1 EEB course at the 300 level or above. Exclusions listed on the Bulletin.

requirements.label: Upper-Level Elective: EEB or MCDB 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: 1 EEB or MCDB course at the 300 level or above. Exclusions listed on the Bulletin.

requirements.label: Total Upper-Level Electives: 6 Credits
requirements.hint: 6 credits of EEB or MCDB coursework at the 300 level or above. Exclusions listed on the Bulletin.

requirements.label: EEB Course Area: Biodiversity Focus (BD)
requirements.hint: 1 course with the BD designation. Approximated here as: EEB 335, 420, 436, 440, 442, 446, 451, or 468. Check the Bulletin for the official BD list.

requirements.label: EEB Course Area: Field or Research Experience (FR)
requirements.hint: 1 course with the FR designation. Approximated here as: EEB 300, 372, 400, 441, or 496. UMBS field courses also count. Check the Bulletin for the official FR list.

requirements.label: Major Credits: minimum 30 credits
requirements.hint: 200-level or above BIOLOGY, EEB, and MCDB courses count toward the 30 credits; approved cognates can also count with department approval. Exclusions apply.

requirements.label: Non-Independent Research: minimum 24 credits
requirements.hint: At least 24 of the 30 major credits must come from courses other than independent research (EEB 300, EEB 400, MCDB 300, MCDB 400, BIOLOGY 200, BIOLOGY 299).
